title: PreorderCommandsStartV1
description: Queue-only trigger (spec 11 §5.3) starting the pre-order saga on the preorder.commands lane (consumer 'preorder.processor'). Enqueued for a confirmed intent that carries a PreorderReference; the reference is copied verbatim from the confirmed, immutable revision (part of the canonical hash, Inv-1/Inv-2). Carries opaque ids + the immutable reference only — never card data, PAN, or transcript text (Inv-12).

operation_id.description: Owning booking operation id (the saga runs under it; Inv-2/3).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.

preorder_reference.description: The immutable PreorderReference (catalog_version, lines, confirmation_id) copied from the confirmed revision; revalidated before commit.

standalone.description: True for a standalone order (§21.4): skips the capacity-hold + booking-commit steps.

slot_id.description: Booking slot the capacity hold is taken against (null for standalone).

requested_capacity.description: Seats/covers to hold for the booking (0/absent for standalone).
